name: b4_scan_sort
goal: B4 turn over to rescan, no handheld scanner: for each of 3 parcels the nearer arm picks it (harness, camera), holds it up; the label is read on the head + both wrist cameras (barcode / QR / pincode OCR); not readable after 10 calls -> the wrist turns it over; A/B from the label (never guessed); WALLX (both claws allowed) puts it into bin A (back) or B (front) and lets go.
setup: Bin A at the back, bin B at the front. 3 parcels on the open table, labels mostly up (one covered). Arms at rest. No phone.
